literal_meaning: কড়কড় শব্দ করা বা কড়কড়ে অবস্থা (যেমন নতুন কাগজ বা নোটের শব্দ)
figurative_meaning_en: Not soiled by use, completely new
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইটি কড়কড়ে, কখনো পড়া হয়নি।
example_sentences_in_english: He had crisp new notes in his pocket.
This book is brand new, never been read.
note: Often used specifically for currency notes to indicate they are unused and clean.
